rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Banned words — grep zero-tolerance.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No matches on `\bhonest\b`, `\bdelve\b`, `\blandscape\b`, `\bimportantly\b`, `\bcrucial\b`, `\bsubstrate\b`, `\bleverage\b`, `\bsynergize\b`, `\bparadigm shift\b`, or em-dashes. Body uses straightforward language: 'asymmetry', 'check', 'delegate', 'verifier', 'gate'. No banned substitutions detected.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Ritual / ceremony — hard ban in any curriculum/training surface.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No 'ritual', 'ceremony', or prohibited 'practice(n)' in body. Body uses: 'asymmetry', 'delegation', 'verifier', 'task', 'check', 'send-off'. Character cultivated via 'delegate', 'agent', 'verifier' vocabulary.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No stale markers, no 'fixed' retrospectives, no session biography.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Body contains no dated retrospectives, no 'NOTE: outdated', no 'retained as historical', no changelog. No session-attribution ('Source: <session>', 'Caught live YYYY-MM-DD'). No transition verbs ('settled', 'retired', 'used to', 'changed to'). Clean present-tense state.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Register match.
rules_evaluated.evidence: AE101 voice quintet reads clearly: Boris-direct ('You hand over the making', 'tedious to read'), Martin-strategic ('Delegation pays where the check is cheap', 'the loop runs fast'), Godin-peer-warm ('The agent finds candidates; you judge them'), Sutherland-reframe (asymmetry as organizing principle), Siilasmaa-forward ('Building the verifier is often the more valuable half'). No preening phrase-pairs, no consultancy register. Register consistent with engineer audience.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Rough-cut drafts for articles.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Not an article draft. File is curriculum prose, not a rough-cut article awaiting rewrite.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Credit original when paraphrasing named technique.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Jason Wei credited inline at point of introduction: 'Jason Wei named the pattern: "some tasks are much easier to verify than to solve."' + named corollary 'the verifier's rule'. M2 principle credited: 'M2 used this without naming it: **find is easier than judge**'. Both citations placed at concept introduction, not buried. No paraphrasing without credit.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Always 'you', never 'the student'; trainer framing stays out of body.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Consistent second person throughout: 'You hand over the making, keep the cheap checking' (line 11); 'you judge them' (line 13); 'Before a send-off, ask' (line 17); 'If you can name one' (line 17); 'Every verifier you write' (line 19). No 'the student' references. No trainer-framing verbs. No delivery mechanics in body.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Don't smuggle terms of art from maintainer into body.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Terms in body ('asymmetry', 'delegation', 'verifier', 'send-off', 'gate', 'check') are either common words or explained in context. 'A diffable expected output' (line 17) is concrete example of verifier type; meaning clear from context. No unexplained maintainer jargon (substrate, compound, self-compound, grill-me, three-pattern) smuggled.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Over-hedge detector.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No reassurance phrases. Body is confident and direct. No 'it's OK if', 'not a penalty', 'no consolation prize', 'you are not on the hook for', 'fine way to', 'not a downgrade'. Delegation framing is structural ('The full cost comes back to you at read time'), not apologetic. Peer voice intact.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Verbatim-frame-cite in reference artefact.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Not a reference artefact. File is supplementary prose, not a reference artifact capturing verbatim user frames. No frame-citation requirement applies.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Cap practitioner attribution at one student-side mention per module.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Wei named once (line 7). M2 referenced once (line 13). Supplementary linked from M4; cap applies per module context. No redundant placement. Both credits front-loaded before student knows move. No bookkeeping or insecurity in attribution count.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Punchy framing keeps punch; carve-out lives downstream.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Two bolded frames: '**the verifier's rule**' and '**find is easier than judge**'. Both accurate to source: Wei's H1 + in-body heading confirm 'rule' not 'law'; M2 exercise confirms 'find is easier than judge'. Neither overstates. Both paired with supporting clauses explaining scope. No false superlatives requiring downstream carve-out.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Value-prop / positioning framing belongs in sales copy + project strategy docs, NOT student-facing curriculum body.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Body teaches principle (asymmetry), does not defend position. No flag phrases: 'not an aspirational', 'not a vendor', 'not theoretical', 'the real practitioners', 'grounded in actual', 'unlike consultancy decks'. No positioning language. No vendor-vs-practitioner framing. No value-prop leak.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Watch out for planting jargon too early.
rules_evaluated.evidence: 'send-off' — supplementary linked from M4 context (maintainer block: 'linked from M4 where the send-off decision makes the asymmetry a governor'). Term earned at M4. 'delegation' — common working term. 'verifier' — explained in context. No LLM-internal vocabulary (token, embedding, retrieval, orchestration) planted. No premature jargon.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Audit closer when trimming body-prose forcing function.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Closing line: 'Every verifier you write converts one more task family from delegation-trap to delegation-win. That is why checks are worth authoring at all.' (lines 18-19). No dangling pronouns. 'That' points clearly to prior sentence. No bypass-the-agent punchlines. Closer lands on maxim, not action verb outside conversation. Well-formed.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: The `**What happened:**` block is OPTIONAL.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Not an exercise. Supplementary prose has no `**What happened:**` block. Rule applies to exercises only. Supplementary correctly omits optional block.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No combative verbs about the agent in body prose.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No verbs describing agent interaction. No 'bark', 'order', 'command', 'whip', 'force', 'drag', 'push around', 'boss', 'shout at', 'snap at', 'lecture', 'scold'. Agents not personified combatively. Reference 'The agent finds candidates; you judge them' (line 13) uses neutral 'finds'. No peer-warmth register violation.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Headers must be literally true about the mechanism.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Header 1 (line 3): 'Checking can cost far less than doing' — TRUE, supported by examples. Header 2 (line 9): 'Why this decides what to delegate' — TRUE, asymmetry is the mechanism. Header 3 (line 15): 'Every send-off needs a named cheap verifier' — TRUE, stated mechanism. No metaphors contradicting mechanism. Headers survive literal cold read.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Machine-cadence fat — four shapes (empty negation, deictic drumroll, bold-label echo, citation duplication).
rules_evaluated.evidence: No empty negation. 'Some are the reverse' (line 6) negates against real prior (line 5). No deictic drumroll. 'That is why checks are worth authoring at all' (line 19) points clearly to prior structure, not announcing restatement. No bold-label echo. No citation duplication: Wei attribution once, M2 reference once, no repeated gloss.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Don't state a count the adjacent list already holds.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No counts stated adjacent to lists. Three verifier examples (line 17: 'A failing test, a compiler, a diffable expected output, a checklist a fresh session can run') carry no adjacent numeral or 'three' clause. No 'these two moves', 'four task sizes' adjacent to their lists.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A slogan that is false as stated is not punchy framing — run the truth test before reaching for §12.
rules_evaluated.evidence: '**the verifier's rule**' — not a slogan; attributed term with supporting clause ('the ease of training AI to solve a task is proportional to how verifiable the task is'). '**find is easier than judge**' — accurate principle, supported by preceding example. No superlatives creating false claims. Both scalable without requiring hedges.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A claim binds to every body that states it, not just the one holding the stamp.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Claims in body trace to wei-asymmetry source (verified in backing block: `[checked:2026-07-26 result:OK due:none]`). Single source-of-truth per claim. Supplementary surface = single body file, so no sibling bodies would create drift. Backing block carries full verification trail.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A rule set reconstructed at session start goes stale inside the session — re-derive it per target, not per sweep.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Evaluation pass, not a multi-file sweep. Rule-staleness applies to sweeps that cache rule set at first file. Single-file evaluation re-derives rules per target.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Aspirational destination, never corrective gap.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Body frames positively: 'Delegation pays where the check is cheap' (advancement), 'Every verifier you write converts one more task family from delegation-trap to delegation-win' (capability-building), 'Building the verifier is often the more valuable half of the work' (re-framing effort). No deficit language, no corrective tone. Engineer caution reframed as engineering virtue.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Earn every technical term on first use.
rules_evaluated.evidence: 'asymmetry' earned immediately: 'The gap between doing-cost and checking-cost is the asymmetry' (line 5). 'delegation' used naturally (common term). 'send-off' used in title and context (supplementary linked from M4, term earned at that module). No OOB terms. M2 abbreviation correct per convention.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Business-audience word ban (Agents 101 default).
rules_evaluated.evidence: No unearned tech words. No flinch-grepping on 'leverage'(v), 'synergize', 'paradigm shift', 'substrate', 'ritual', 'ceremony'. Vocabulary: 'asymmetry', 'delegation', 'verifier', 'gate', 'check' — all plain or earned. Passes SVP cold-read test.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Memory vs context — use deliberately.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No 'memory' or 'context' language in body. Rule applies to prose discussing persistent artifact vs ambient state. Not triggered here.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Golden path only in body — THIS RULE HAS AN EXCEPTION; read to the boundary before cutting anything.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No troubleshooting, recovery, 'what if X fails' branches in body. Body = calm forward-moving narrative. No pre-emptive FAQ. No time-critical rescue routed to maintainer block improperly. Supplementary is optional reference, not time-gated exercise.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Trust Claude's defaults for structure.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No prompts in body. Rule applies to prompt-specification. Not triggered.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Always 'you', never 'the student'; teacher framing stays out of body.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Consistent second person: 'You hand over the making' (line 11), 'you judge them' (line 13), 'Before a send-off, ask' (line 17), 'If you can name one' (line 17), 'Every verifier you write' (line 19). No 'the student' or 'the trainer'. No delivery mechanics. In student-facing body, 'you' = student throughout.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Don't smuggle another module's voice.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Supplementary = optional reading linked from M4. Voice consistent with AE101 quintet. No M1 joyful-creation register, no M5 long-running mood, no M6 closing voice misapplied. Register stays steady and appropriate to principle-teaching surface.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Don't ask student to manually diff or spot-check Claude's output as error-catching.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No 'read for errors', 'spot-check', 'manually diff' instructions. Body teaches principle, not error-detection mechanics. No ask for emotional reading of output. No competing with M5/M6.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Simulation personas never alone.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No simulations in body. Supplementary is prose, not simulation. Rule applies to simulation content only.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No 'What research says' callout boxes.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No callout boxes. No research-says framing. Wei attribution is inline citation at point of use, not a boxed callout.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Student moves stay in conversation with agent.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No student moves specified outside conversation. Supplementary teaches principle. No editor/terminal/file-edit primitives asked of student outside agent conversation.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Specify which CLAUDE.md layer — every time.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No CLAUDE.md references in body. Rule fires when referencing layer. Not triggered.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No em-dashes. Simple sentences.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No em-dashes found. Sentences simple: 'You hand over the making, keep the cheap checking, and the loop runs fast.' (comma, not dash). No complex sub-clauses via em-dash. Parentheses rare and appropriate. Readable aloud.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Audit closer when trimming body-prose forcing function (Checkpoint for dangling pronouns).
rules_evaluated.evidence: Pronouns/demonstratives checked: 'That' (line 19: 'That is why checks are worth authoring at all') points clearly to 'Every verifier you write converts one more task family' (line 18). No dangling. No bypass-the-agent punchlines. Closer lands on maxim, not action verb sending student outside.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Section headers use command verbs when section is about doing something (Applies to exercises and Debriefs; Lectures may use declarative).
rules_evaluated.evidence: Headers use declarative noun-phrase form, which is correct for supplementary prose. 'Checking can cost far less than doing' (noun + comparative); 'Why this decides what to delegate' (noun + verb describing mechanism). Supplementary is reference/principle, not action-based. Exempt from command-verb requirement.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Inline links use target's title, never filename.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No inline links in body. No cross-references to curriculum surfaces. Rule fires when linking; not triggered here.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No time-of-day anchors in body prose.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No time-of-day references ('tomorrow', 'overnight', 'this morning', 'tonight', 'next morning', 'yesterday', 'last night'). No module-relative timing. Body is time-neutral.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Reflection beats stay invisible in flow.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No reflection-beat labeling. No 'Pause before you promote', 'Meta-moment', 'The reflection beat', 'Step back', 'Moment of truth'. No contemplative-pause prefixes. Body = straightforward principle, no pedagogy-aware framing announcing reflection.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No meta-ask when student has already decided.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No prompts in body. No meta-loops asking student to declare what they already decided. Rule fires on prompt-ask mechanics; not triggered.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: `.md` is default file type for student artifacts across curriculum.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No student artifact-saving prompts in body. Supplementary is prose, not exercise with save-directive. Rule fires on Save-it-as prompts; not triggered.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Cut NVA: true but not moving student forward.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Every clause moves student forward. 'Some tasks are far cheaper to check than to do' + examples establish asymmetry principle. 'Jason Wei named the pattern' advances understanding. 'Delegation pays' and 'delegation is a trap' teach decision. 'Before a send-off, ask' gives operative framework. No implementation detail before use. No administrative aside. No extra source trivia. No unnecessary mechanism explanation.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Body 'read it' / 'look at it' / 'notice X' after chat-print = dead weight.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No chat-print in supplementary. No 'Read it', 'Look at it', 'Study the X', 'Notice the row'. Rule fires after agent chat-output; not triggered.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Forward-callout closer: student as grammatical subject.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Closing sentences use student or artifact as subject. 'Every verifier you write converts...' — student as subject (you). 'That is why checks are worth authoring at all' — checks (artifact) + imperative (implied worth). No training/curriculum as subject. No generic 'they'. No role-gating or audience-shift. No coach-register. Subject test passes.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Operational reminders live at moment of use, not only where introduced.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No operational settings (thinking-effort, model choice, mode tag, slash-command). Supplementary is principle-teaching, not operational guidance.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Echo the training's theory spine before inventing a synonym.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Body echoes AE101 house frames: 'the loop' (line 13: 'it runs through the whole far half of the map'); 'gate' + 'check' concepts (line 17); 'send-off' (line 15 title). No invented synonyms replacing theory-spine terms. House vocabulary reinforced.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Name the artifact, not the act.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No prompts in body directing 'paste this', 'send this', 'run this'. Rule fires on prompt-as-artifact naming; not triggered.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Name the outcome; don't walk a professional through trivial mechanics.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No setup instructions (install CLI, auth flow, browser login). Supplementary is principle-teaching. Rule fires on procedural steps; not triggered.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: The curriculum does not narrate itself.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Body does not position itself in arc. No 'this module covers', 'by the end you'll', 'this training shows', 'the training pools'. No arc-positioning. Focuses on principle (asymmetry) and its application. Supplementary earns exemption from sequencing rules by teaching principle, not placement. Subject test passes: body about asymmetry + delegation, not about training structure.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Earn every technical term on first use (Earn ≠ only lookup, covers two more cases).
rules_evaluated.evidence: All technical terms earned or plain. 'asymmetry' earned immediately (line 5). 'delegation' — common term. 'send-off' — earned at M4. M2 abbreviation correct per convention. No corpus vocabulary planted unearned. House frames ('the loop', 'gate/check') already established by M4 context.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Name the artifact, not the act — version 2.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No prompt-save directives ('Save it as X'). No consumership claim without downstream reader ('keep this somewhere', 'write this down'). Supplementary prose = no artifact-saving instructions. Rule fires on save-directive prompts; body passes by not requiring apply.
